channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Iran dismisses Trump's 'economic D-Day' threat as more 'failed policies'
item.description: Iran shrugged off President Trump's threat of an 'economic D-Day,' calling it a continuation of failed policies.

item.title: Pilot dies in Pennsylvania plane-helicopter collision
item.description: A small plane and a state police helicopter collided in central Pennsylvania, killing the pilot and injuring two troopers.

item.title: Data center backlash may cost GOP Ohio Senate seat, Republicans warn
item.description: Controversial data centers are influencing the Ohio Senate race.

item.title: Trump unveils new White House helipad, adds signature
item.description: President Trump showcased the new granite helipad at the White House on Wednesday.
